data.name: About_Disclaimer
data.value: FINAL FANTASY is a registered trademark of Square Enix Holdings Co., Ltd. XIV ConfigSync is an independent, non-commercial open-source project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed or supported by Square Enix or the Dalamud project. It contains no material from the game.

data.name: About_Text
data.value: XIV ConfigSync backs up the client settings of the game and the settings of Dalamud plugins into a folder you sync with OneDrive, and applies them on your other PCs. It only copies whole files while the game is closed. It never reads game memory, never talks to game servers and never changes the game. Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later.

data.name: Area_character_Hint
data.value: Name plates, camera, battle effects, pets and the other character settings, without the chat. Also the friend list data, the item search and appearance presets from character creation.

data.name: Area_chat_Hint
data.value: Font size, transparency, tabs, filters, channels, colours and chat bubbles of the chat window. Each can be switched on its own. The size and position of the chat window belong to the HUD layout.

data.name: Area_controls_Hint
data.value: Key bindings and the settings for mouse and keyboard and for the game pad: camera, targeting and what the HUD shows.

data.name: Area_hotbars_Hint
data.value: Hotbars, cross hotbars, character macros and shared macros, and how the hotbars are shown.

data.name: Area_hud_Hint
data.value: Size and position of all windows on screen, the chat window included. The game rewrites this file on every login, so when both PCs changed it, the state backed up last wins.

data.name: Area_inventory_Hint
data.value: The order of items in inventory, saddlebag and retainers. The game changes it by itself, so the state backed up last wins.

data.name: Area_plugins_Hint
data.value: The settings of your Dalamud plugins. Single plugins can get their own rule on the Plugins tab.

data.name: Area_repositories_Hint
data.value: Custom plugin repositories another PC has and this one lacks are added to Dalamud here. None is removed, and no other Dalamud setting changes.

data.name: Backup_Unchanged
data.value: Nothing changed since the last backup.

data.name: Cleanup_Changed
data.value: changed since it was listed; please list again

data.name: Cleanup_Confirm
data.value: Move {0} conflict copies to the Recycle Bin? Only the ticked files are moved. You can restore them from the Recycle Bin.

data.name: Cleanup_Done
data.value: {0} conflict copies were moved to the Recycle Bin.

data.name: Cleanup_Gone
data.value: no longer there, or no longer a conflict copy

data.name: Cleanup_Intro
data.value: When OneDrive cannot merge two versions of a file, it keeps both and names the second one after the computer, for example FFXIV-PC2.cfg. The game ignores these copies, and this application neither backs them up nor transfers them. Tick the ones you no longer need; they go to the Recycle Bin, so you can restore them from there. Nothing is removed unless you tick it and confirm. A copy whose original is missing cannot be ticked, since it may be the only version left.

data.name: Cleanup_None
data.value: No conflict copies in the game folder.

data.name: Cleanup_OriginalMissing
data.value: The original is missing; kept, as it may be the only version.

data.name: Cleanup_Remove
data.value: Move ticked files to the Recycle Bin

data.name: Close_AskText
data.value: Should XIV ConfigSync keep running in the notification area when you close the window? Yes: keep running, so backups after playing still happen. No: quit. You can change this in the settings.

data.name: Close_Busy
data.value: An operation is still running. Please wait until it has finished.

data.name: Error_Settings
data.value: The settings in {0} could not be read. Rename or remove the file to start with new settings.

data.name: Error_Unexpected
data.value: An unexpected error occurred. The details are in the log. The application stays open.

data.name: Exclude_ConflictCopy
data.value: conflict copy of a cloud client

data.name: Exclude_Shadow
data.value: Dalamud's shadow copy of the settings

data.name: FirstContact_Question
data.value: This PC and {0} have not exchanged settings before, and {1} files differ between them. Yes takes the settings from {0}; the files here are saved first. No keeps the settings of this PC, and {0} takes them from here. Cancel decides later on the Transfer page.

data.name: Flag_Path
data.value: Contains paths of the other device.

data.name: Matrix_Accounts
data.value: The launcher's list of accounts (names, no passwords). Belongs to this device.

data.name: Matrix_Acq
data.value: Acquaintance list and related character data.

data.name: Matrix_Addon
data.value: HUD layout. The game changes this file by itself on every login, so it is only applied on request.

data.name: Matrix_Cfgcopy
data.value: Holds the character's name and IDs; belongs to this device.

data.name: Matrix_Common
data.value: Character settings (chat, name plates, camera). Not yet confirmed by a transfer.

data.name: Matrix_Control0
data.value: Mouse and keyboard mode settings, including HUD info display. Confirmed by a transfer.

data.name: Matrix_Control1
data.value: Game pad mode settings. Not yet confirmed by a transfer.

data.name: Matrix_DalamudConfig
data.value: Dalamud's own settings: plugin repositories, which plugins are on, profiles, fonts. Never applied from another device as a whole; the repository list can be merged on the Transfer page.

data.name: Matrix_DalamudOther
data.value: Another file in Dalamud's folder. Belongs to this device.

data.name: Matrix_DalamudUi
data.value: Positions of Dalamud's windows; valid only at this screen size.

data.name: Matrix_FfxivCfg
data.value: Graphics, resolution, UI scale and sound of this device. Never applied from another device as a whole.

data.name: Matrix_Gearset
data.value: Gear sets. Not yet confirmed by a transfer.

data.name: Matrix_Gs
data.value: Further character data. Not yet confirmed by a transfer.

data.name: Matrix_Hotbar
data.value: Hotbars and cross hotbars. Confirmed by a transfer.

data.name: Matrix_ItemFinder
data.value: Item finder data. Not yet confirmed by a transfer.

data.name: Matrix_ItemOrder
data.value: Inventory order. The game changes it by itself; only on request.

data.name: Matrix_Keybind
data.value: Key bindings. Confirmed by a transfer.

data.name: Matrix_LauncherConfig
data.value: Settings of XIVLauncher on this device: game path, patch path, window.

data.name: Matrix_LogFilter
data.value: Chat log filters. Not yet confirmed by a transfer.

data.name: Matrix_Macro
data.value: Character macros. Not yet confirmed by a transfer.

data.name: Matrix_MacroSys
data.value: Macros shared by all characters. Confirmed by a transfer.

data.name: Matrix_Plugin
data.value: Plugin settings. Applied only on request.

data.name: Matrix_UiSave
data.value: UI state. The game changes it by itself; only on request.

data.name: Matrix_Unknown
data.value: Unknown file; backed up, applied only on request.

data.name: Notify_Conflicts
data.value: {0} files from {1} were also changed here. Please decide on the Transfer page.

data.name: Overview_ConflictCopies
data.value: {0} old conflict copies were found in the game folder. They are neither backed up nor transferred; under Clean up you can look at them and move the ones you tick to the Recycle Bin.

data.name: Overview_FolderUnavailable
data.value: The sync folder {0} is not reachable right now (a drive not connected, OneDrive not started?). The application tries again; nothing is lost. To use another folder, choose Change sync folder in the settings.

data.name: Overview_GameRunning
data.value: Game is running: nothing is written

data.name: Overview_Intro
data.value: This device backs up its settings into its own part of the sync folder. On the Transfer page you take settings from another device or from an older backup.

data.name: Overview_NotReceived
data.value: not confirmed by another device yet

data.name: Part_character_sizes
data.value: Sizes of map, tooltips, flying text and inventory

data.name: Part_hotbars_display
data.value: Hotbar display and cross hotbar settings

data.name: Reason_BothChanged
data.value: Changed on both devices since they last matched. Both versions are kept; you decide.

data.name: Reason_LocalChangedOnly
data.value: Only changed here; the source still has the common state.

data.name: Reason_LocalNewerState
data.value: Both changed it; the game rewrites this file by itself. This PC's state is the later one and stays.

data.name: Reason_MissingLocally
data.value: Does not exist on this device yet.

data.name: Reason_NoCommonState
data.value: Different on both devices and no common state is known yet (first transfer). You decide.

data.name: Reason_NotScanned
data.value: Left out of this device's backup (by a rule, size or link); taken only by hand.

data.name: Reason_OnlyHere
data.value: Only this device has the file; the chosen backup does not. It is never deleted.

data.name: Reason_OnRequestRule
data.value: Newer on the source; applied only on request.

data.name: Reason_Restore
data.value: Differs from the chosen older backup.

data.name: Reason_SourceNewerState
data.value: Both changed it; the game rewrites this file by itself. The source backed it up later, so its state is taken.

data.name: Reason_SourceOutdated
data.value: The source has an older state of this file.

data.name: Recovery_LeftAlone
data.value: {0} files changed after the interruption and were left as they are. You can take them on the Transfer page.

data.name: Recovery_Text
data.value: A transfer or an undo was interrupted, for example by a power cut or because the game was started. Yes: finish it. No: go back to the state before it. Cancel: decide later.

data.name: Refuse_AlreadySyncFolder
data.value: This folder is already a sync folder. Choose it to join it instead of creating a new one.

data.name: Refuse_Busy
data.value: Another operation is running. Please try again in a moment.

data.name: Refuse_ChangedSincePlan
data.value: Some files changed since the comparison, for example because the game ran. Nothing was written. Please compare again.

data.name: Refuse_DalamudSettingsUnknown
data.value: Dalamud's settings have a form this application does not know. Nothing was changed.

data.name: Refuse_Damaged
data.value: Some files of this backup are missing or damaged, possibly because OneDrive has not finished downloading them. Nothing was applied. Try again later.

data.name: Refuse_FolderChanged
data.value: The game or plugin folder was changed in the settings since this was saved. Set the folder back to finish or undo it.

data.name: Refuse_FolderMissing
data.value: The game settings folder of this device cannot be found. Check the folder in the settings; nothing is transferred into a folder that is not there.

data.name: Refuse_GameRunning
data.value: The game is running. Nothing is written to its files while it runs; this happens after you close it.

data.name: Refuse_GameVersion
data.value: The game version differs between the two devices. Please update the game on both devices first.

data.name: Refuse_NoDalamudSettings
data.value: Dalamud's settings (dalamudConfig.json) were not found on this device. Check the plugin folder in the settings, and that plugins are backed up.

data.name: Refuse_NoRevision
data.value: This device has no backup yet.

data.name: Refuse_NoSnapshot
data.value: This transfer can no longer be undone.

data.name: Refuse_NoSyncFolder
data.value: No sync folder is set up.

data.name: Refuse_OpenJournal
data.value: An interrupted transfer or undo must be finished or rolled back first. Close the game if it runs, then press Refresh on the overview to be asked.

data.name: Refuse_SourceNoDalamudSettings
data.value: The latest backup of that device has no Dalamud settings yet. It needs this version of the application and one backup.

data.name: Refuse_SyncFolderUnavailable
data.value: The sync folder is not reachable right now. Connect the drive or start OneDrive, then try again.

data.name: Refuse_UnknownDevice
data.value: This device is not in the sync folder.

data.name: Rules_ExclusionsIntro
data.value: Files matching these patterns are not backed up. * matches within a folder, ** across folders. Caches, logs and lock files are always left out.

data.name: Rules_Intro
data.value: Everything is backed up. Switch on what this PC takes from your other PCs; the application knows which files belong to what. Taken over is what only the other PC changed, without asking; a copy is saved first and the Transfer page can undo it. These switches apply to this PC only.

data.name: Rules_NeverWarning
data.value: Careful: this file holds settings of one device. Taking it from another device can change resolution, graphics or UI scale.

data.name: Rules_PluginsIntro
data.value: Every plugin is backed up. Here you can give a single plugin its own rule: always, on request or never. "As the area" follows the area "Plugin settings". "Not backed up" leaves a plugin out of the backup; it then also shows under the exclusions.

data.name: Rules_ResetConfirm
data.value: Switch every area on and set every rule back to its default? Your exclusions stay.

data.name: Rules_Title
data.value: What is taken from other PCs

data.name: Settings_AutoApply
data.value: Take the areas switched on from other PCs automatically (with a backup first)

data.name: Settings_Autostart
data.value: Start with Windows (in the notification area)

data.name: Settings_ChangeFolderConfirm
data.value: The set-up runs again. Nothing in the current sync folder is deleted. Continue?

data.name: Settings_CharactersIntro
data.value: Give each character folder a name. Where a plugin knows the character (for example AutoRetainer or Lifestream), its name and world are suggested and used for characters without a name of your own. The application never shows the IDs in the folder names.

data.name: Settings_LanguageRestart
data.value: Saved. The new language applies after a restart.

data.name: Settings_LauncherFound
data.value: Dalamud found: its settings and the plugin settings are backed up from here. Plugins themselves are installed by Dalamud.

data.name: Settings_LauncherMissing
data.value: No Dalamud in this folder. Usually it is %APPDATA%\XIVLauncher.

data.name: Settings_MinimizeOnClose
data.value: Keep running in the notification area when the window is closed

data.name: Settings_TakeSuggestions
data.value: Use the names from plugin data

data.name: Setup_AgainDevice
data.value: This PC is already in the sync folder and was set up again:

data.name: Setup_AgainRecent
data.value: {0} was active on {1}. Set this PC up as {0} only if that PC is no longer used; two PCs under one name would disturb each other. Continue?

data.name: Setup_DeviceHint
data.value: The name is shown on your other devices.

data.name: Setup_DoneAgain
data.value: This PC is set up again under its old name. Its last backups are on the Transfer page if you want to restore one. The other PCs will not take anything from this PC without asking until you have compared once.

data.name: Setup_DoneJoined
data.value: This device is set up and backed up. On the Transfer page you can now take the settings of your other device.

data.name: Setup_DoneNew
data.value: The sync folder is set up and this device is backed up. On your next PC, choose the same folder or double-click the .xivsync file in it.

data.name: Setup_DoneNoBackup
data.value: This device is set up. The first backup could not be made yet and follows automatically: {0}

data.name: Setup_Folder_Empty
data.value: A new sync folder will be created here.

data.name: Setup_Folder_Foreign
data.value: This folder contains other files. Please choose an empty folder or an existing sync folder.

data.name: Setup_Folder_Invalid
data.value: This folder contains more than one or a damaged .xivsync file and cannot be used.

data.name: Setup_Folder_Sync
data.value: Existing sync folder. Devices in it: {1}. This device joins them.

data.name: Setup_FolderIntro
data.value: Choose one folder inside your OneDrive. Use the same folder on every PC; the application organises everything inside it.

data.name: Setup_FoldersIntro
data.value: These folders were found on this PC. Change them only if the game or Dalamud is installed elsewhere.

data.name: Setup_GameFolderMissing
data.value: No game settings found in this folder. It is usually Documents\My Games\FINAL FANTASY XIV - A Realm Reborn.

data.name: Setup_GameVersionUnknown
data.value: Game version not found. Transfers still work, but versions cannot be compared.

data.name: Setup_NewDevice
data.value: Add this PC as a new device

data.name: Setup_OptionsHint
data.value: All of this can be changed later in the settings.

data.name: Setup_OptionsIntro
data.value: What should happen without you asking?

data.name: Setup_Running
data.value: Setting up and creating the first backup...

data.name: Setup_Welcome
data.value: Welcome. XIV ConfigSync keeps the settings of the game and your Dalamud plugins the same on all your PCs, without overwriting what belongs to one PC, such as resolution or UI scale.

data.name: Status_Cleaning
data.value: Moving files to the Recycle Bin...

data.name: SyncFile_OtherFolder

data.name: Transfer_AllConflicts
data.value: Take all conflicts from the source

data.name: Transfer_ConfirmSensitive

data.name: Transfer_Done

data.value: Choose a device and a backup, then compare. Files with a check mark are taken over. Nothing is written until you confirm, and every transfer can be undone.

data.name: Transfer_NothingToUndo
data.value: There is no transfer to undo.

data.name: Transfer_NotInSource
data.value: {0} files exist only on this device, not in the chosen backup (for example a plugin installed only here). They stay as they are; nothing needs to be done. "Also show files with nothing to do" lists them.

data.name: Transfer_RepositoriesConfirm
data.value: These {0} plugin repositories of {1} are added to Dalamud's settings on this device:{2}Repositories already there and all other settings stay as they are. You can undo it with "Undo last transfer".

data.value: Undo the transfer of {0}? {1} files are set back to the state before it.

data.value: XIV ConfigSync keeps running here in the notification area. Quit it with a right click on the icon.

data.name: Upload_Unknown

data.value: The game version of one device is unknown, so it cannot be compared.

data.name: Warn_PluginsOff
data.value: The source also has plugin settings. They are not offered because this device does not back up plugin settings (see Settings).
